name: whynot-cut
description: AI post-production for Arabic/English vertical reels and podcasts: raw footage to a native Premiere Pro project, podcast reel plans and publish copy, motion videos in After Effects, evidence-based QC. macOS and Windows.

clients_root.title: Client folders location
clients_root.description: Folder that contains your client folders (each with assets/ and data/), e.g. D:\WhyNot Clients or ~/Documents/WhyNot Clients. /whynot-cut:start can set this up for you.

engine_home.title: Engine data folder
engine_home.description: Where the Python environment, Whisper models (~3 GB) and the Premiere job queue live. Leave empty for ~/.whynot-cut (an existing ~/.reel-editor install is reused).

language.title: Language
language.description: The language WhyNot Cut talks to you in: ar (Arabic, Egyptian-friendly) or en (English). A client or machine preferences file overrides it.

approval.title: Plan approval
approval.description: ask = always stop and wait for your approval of the plan before building. auto = show the plan and preview, then go on (you delegate the approval). A client or machine preferences file overrides it.

whisper_model.title: Transcription model
whisper_model.description: large-v3 = the most accurate (default). large-v3-turbo = faster. medium and small = lightest, for weak machines. Whisper models are downloaded once into the engine data folder.

magnific_budget_credits.title: Magnific credit budget
magnific_budget_credits.description: The most Magnific credits one edit may spend on generated B-roll and upscales; the plan shows the cost before anything is spent. 0 = never use Magnific.

magnific_api_key.title: Magnific API key
magnific_api_key.description: Optional. Lets WhyNot Cut generate stock-style B-roll with Magnific. Stored by Claude Code in your system keychain, never written to a project or engine file. Leave empty to skip Magnific.
